description: US nursing-home Medicaid, 2026: savings above the state asset limit, what a spouse at home keeps and their monthly income allowance, months the savings pay for care, the look-back penalty…

assetLimit.description: State asset limit, if known (overrides ours)

assets.description: Countable savings and investments, USD (a couple: both together; not the home)

costMonthly.description: Nursing home cost a month, USD (default: the state’s penalty divisor)

giftsInLookback.description: Gifts or below-value transfers in the look-back, USD

incomeMonthly.description: The person’s gross income a month, USD

married.description: A spouse still lives at home

penaltyDivisor.description: State penalty divisor a month, if known (overrides ours)

waiver.description: A Medicaid waiver pays for assisted living or home care
